text: ポケモンに　もたせると　じぶんで　じょうたい　いじょうを　なおす。

structure.jp: ポケモンに　もたせると
structure.en: if you have a Pokémon hold it

structure.jp: じょうたい　いじょうを　なおす。

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.span: ポケモンに　もたせる
patterns.explanation: もたせる is もつ 'to hold' changed to mean 'to make or let someone hold'; the one who holds gets に. ポケモンに　もたせる = 'have a Pokémon hold it'.

patterns.name: 〜と (if/when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever the first thing happens, the second always follows. もたせると = 'if you give it to hold'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells you by what means something is done. じぶんで = 'by itself', with no help from the trainer.
